02 · 14 resources

Frameworks and orchestration platforms

The frameworks below all let you wire STT, an LLM, and TTS together. For open-source production work, LiveKit Agents and Pipecat are the two safest bets; for managed dashboards, Vapi, Retell, and Bland win on time-to-first-call.

Suggested learning path: Week 2: First agent

PickTypeBest for
LiveKit AgentsOpen sourceProduction, WebRTC-native
PipecatOpen sourceVendor-neutral pipelines
Vapi / Retell / BlandManagedFastest first call
OpenAI Realtime / Gemini LiveRealtime APISpeech-to-speech

14 resources

  • LiveKit Agents: Voice AI Quickstartdocs.livekit.io

    Working assistant in <10 min via Python or TypeScript, runs on top of WebRTC.

    BeginnerOpen-source frameworks
  • Pipecat: Quickstartdocs.pipecat.ai

    Scaffolds a Deepgram + OpenAI + Cartesia pipeline via the Pipecat CLI (uv tool install pipecat-ai-cli, then pipecat init quickstart); talk to it in the browser in ~5 minutes.

    BeginnerOpen-source frameworks
  • Ultravox (fixie-ai/ultravox)github.com

    Open-weight multimodal speech LLM (Llama/Gemma/Qwen variants) that skips the separate ASR stage for ~150 ms TTFT.

    AdvancedOpen-source frameworks
  • qwen-audio-agentgithub.com

    Full-duplex voice runtime that drives coding agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and other ACP backends) with barge-in, parallel background tasks, and a local wake word.

    IntermediateOpen-source frameworks
  • Vapi: Quickstartdocs.vapi.ai

    Dashboard-first; ship an agent on a free US phone number in under 5 minutes.

    BeginnerManaged platforms
  • Retell AI: Introduction & Quickstartdocs.retellai.com

    Phone-agent platform with $10 free credit on signup.

    BeginnerManaged platforms
  • Bland AI: Send Your First Phone Callbland.ai

    Minimal API tutorial for placing your first AI phone call.

    BeginnerManaged platforms
  • ElevenLabs Agents: Quickstartelevenlabs.io

    Build and embed a voice agent widget on any website in 5 minutes (formerly branded "Conversational AI," now ElevenAgents).

    BeginnerManaged platforms
  • OpenAI Realtime API: Guidedevelopers.openai.com

    Official guide to gpt-realtime-2 (GA; GPT-5-class with configurable reasoning) over WebRTC, WebSockets, or SIP.

    IntermediateRealtime / speech-to-speech APIs
  • Google Gemini Live API: Overviewai.google.dev

    Low-latency, bidirectional voice + vision agents with barge-in and tool use, on Gemini native audio.

    IntermediateRealtime / speech-to-speech APIs
  • Twilio ConversationRelaytwilio.com

    WebSocket bridge that handles STT/TTS so you focus on LLM logic; works with any LLM.

    IntermediateRealtime / speech-to-speech APIs
  • Vapi vs Pipecat vs LiveKit (AssemblyAI)assemblyai.com

    Architecture-focused comparison of pipeline control and transport choices.

    IntermediateVendor-neutral comparisons
  • 11 Voice Agent Platforms Compared (Softcery)softcery.com

    Broad market map with use-case recommendations.

    BeginnerVendor-neutral comparisons
  • Best Voice Agent Stack (Hamming AI)hamming.ai

    Buy-vs-build framework with concrete cost, latency, and time-to-launch numbers.

    IntermediateVendor-neutral comparisons
